997.string: constant k of odometer or chronotachograph           #00693
997.note_text: characteristic quantity showing the type (revolutions of the driving shaft or impulses) and number of signals which the odometer or chronotachograph must receive so that the indicated and/or recorded distance increases by 1 km. The constant k may be expressed in revolutions per kilometre, rev/km, or impulses per kilometre, imp/km
